...
1. Interactive Brokers- The Interactive Brokers Forum is home to a strong community of knowledgable traders. Compared to other communities we’ve explored, the IBKR Forum suits the more experienced trader with some advanced concepts and trading themes discussed. It’s also an excellent hub for resources on Interactive Brokers’ tools and services, including APIs and reporting. The filtering options are a step above most community feeds we’ve been on, allowing you to select by categories, authors, titles, published dates, and more. 
2. NinjaTrader- NinjaTrader fosters an active trading community, with its forum receiving a revamp and migrating to a cleaner interface. It’s a good option for futures traders, especially those wanting to learn how to use and get the most out of the NinjaTrader software. title: 5 Best Day Trading Communities & Groups (2026)
snippet:
Here are 5 of the best day trading communities in 2026 - with TradeMomentum as the go-to choice.
...
- The best trading community isn’t the loudest - it’s the one that reinforces process, risk discipline, and consistency.
- TradeMomentum is #1 in 2026 because it combines live execution context, nightly watchlists, and accountability (the ingredients most traders are missing).
- Communities are useful for learning faster, but dangerous if they push constant activity and “hot ticker” chasing.
- Choose a community that matches your style (momentum vs. catalysts vs. structured education) and then commit long enough to build a routine.
